200.title: International Commission of Jurists criticises takeover of Polish constitutional court
200.summary: International Commission of Jurists criticises takeover of Polish constitutional court Nov 4, 2026 | Law Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work! The International Commission of Jurists (ICJ) has criticised the takeover of Poland’s Constitutional Tribunal (TK) by a group of government-backed judges.
200.body: International Commission of Jurists criticises takeover of Polish constitutional court Nov 4, 2026 | Law Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work! The International Commission of Jurists (ICJ) has criticised the takeover of Poland’s Constitutional Tribunal (TK) by a group of government-backed judges. However, the ICJ, a Swiss-based NGO led by judges, lawyers and academics from around the world, also chastised Poland’s opposition-aligned president, Karol Nawrocki, for his role in the crisis around the TK, in particular his refusal to swear in judges elected by parliament. 🚨 #Poland ’s constitutional crisis must be resolved through the rule of law. Poland’s government, including Prime Minister Donald Tusk, has also argued that the takeover of the tribunal was necessary to ensure that legally appointed judges can take up their seats and that the court’s legitimacy can be restored.

200.body: Polish Prime Minister Tusk proposes meeting with President Nawrocki 217 Today, 12:25 Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk, following a meeting of Poland’s National Security Council, proposed that President Karol Nawrocki hold a face-to-face meeting this week. 600.title: Polish volleyball league opposed Italian clubs: We want an urgent change to the calendar!
600.summary: While Italian clubs are opposing the changes to the world calendar proposed by the International Volleyball Federation (FIVB), the Polish Professional Volleyball League (PLS) has officially insisted on the fastest possible reform of the current system.
600.body: While Italian clubs are opposing the changes to the world calendar proposed by the International Volleyball Federation (FIVB), the Polish Professional Volleyball League (PLS) has officially insisted on the fastest possible reform of the current system. Poland: The current calendar hinders the development of volleyball According to the Polish league, dividing the year into two independent periods – club and national – creates serious problems for the organization of championships and the health of athletes. "The Polish Professional Volleyball League recommends taking urgent action and ending the stagnation that has lasted for years," states the concluding part of the official statement. One problem, two opposing positions While Gino Sirci and the Italian clubs supporting him warn of the risks of interrupting national championships in winter, the Polish side believes that the current division between club and national season is already causing serious damage.
